run_feature_extraction: run the FeatureExtractor to extract FRCNN features from images in a directory and save to output folder
build_detection_model: build a GeneralizedRCNN detection model from a pretrained model file and config using _build_detection_model
extract_frcnn_features: extract FRCNN object detection features from a list of image paths using get_frcnn_features
process_features: process raw FRCNN features by filtering confidence thresholds and extracting ROI features via _process_features
save_features: save extracted features as numpy arrays to the output folder using _save_feature
